name: Upgradex (Upgrade Tree)
desc:
Have we been here before?
Made by the people known from projects like Everything Upgrade Tree, Upgradex revisits on the upgrade tree genre with a new sleek look, many different upgrades and interesting mechanics. Go from the simplest fundamentals to a manifold of discoveries!

We do not allow use of macros, multi-accounting or any sort of exploits regardless if they give a competitive edge or not (Exception to autoclickers that click only one spot). Failure to comply will result in the termination of your savefiles.

RELEASE 1.1
Check out our community server (16+ Social Links) to stay updated on new things!
